name: Nishizono Sayuki
source:
She's a kind mother who cherishes her daughter, but lately she seems to be feeling lonely...

She is a gentle, easygoing woman who usually spends her days quietly and peacefully at home. She cares deeply about Miyuri and often looks out for her, but she is completely unaware that Miyuri has a boyfriend. While out shopping, she accidentally crashes her bicycle into Yachitaka, an encounter that sends her life spiraling dramatically off course. In reality, she has been living with persistent sexual frustration and often secretly relieves herself on her own.

Occupation:Part-time work, etc.
Things she likes:Fried udon,cats,chained collar
